guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「瓶級PET的材質純化、乾燥與去污驗證」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow bottle-grade pet purification, drying and decontamination validation through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「原料來源與非目標混入」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.012 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只以透明外觀篩選會漏掉同色異材與不同前用途。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「整瓶與瓶片的雙段分選」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.5 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「瓶蓋與標籤的浮沉去向」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.95 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只量沉料總重會把異材重量當PET。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「瓶片污染的ppm基準」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 mg/kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「一小杯未見異材不能證明整噸無異材。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「含水率與水解風險」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.1 kg water，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「料層短路可能讓平均乾燥條件掩蓋濕料。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「鏈長與黏度趨勢」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.1 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「忽略測試條件可能把方法偏差誤認熱降解。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「去污挑戰試驗的去除率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.995 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只展示最好去除率會隱藏難去除污染。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「殘餘濃度的最壞情境」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.015 mg/kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「四捨五入成100%去除會錯誤得到零殘餘。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「關鍵條件偏差與批次隔離」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 100 kg，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只隔離警報時刻的一袋會漏掉管線及反應器存料。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「批次放行與證據鏈」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.96 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用全廠平均紀錄補填缺失批次會破壞追溯。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for input provenance and non-target mixing, first reproduce 0.012 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Transparency alone misses same-colour foreign resins and previous uses." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for whole-bottle and flake sorting, first reproduce 0.5 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for caps, labels and sink-float outlets, first reproduce 0.95 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Sink mass alone counts foreign resin as PET." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for parts-per-million contamination basis, first reproduce 30 mg/kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "No visible contamination in one small cup does not prove a tonne is clean." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for moisture and hydrolysis risk, first reproduce 0.1 kg water, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Bed short-circuiting can conceal wet material behind average dryer conditions." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for chain length and viscosity trend, first reproduce 0.1 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ignoring test conditions can mistake method bias for thermal degradation." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for removal in a decontamination challenge test, first reproduce 0.995 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reporting only the best removal conceals difficult contaminants." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for worst-case residual concentration, first reproduce 0.015 mg/kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Rounding removal to100% falsely produces zero residue." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for critical-condition deviations and batch segregation, first reproduce 100 kg, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Isolating one bag at alarm time misses material in equipment." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for batch release and evidence chain, first reproduce 0.96 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Filling missing lot records with plant averages breaks traceability." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 比對進貨紀錄與分層抽樣中的非目標物。
用同一組難辨識異材追蹤兩段漏選是否相關。
分析浮料中的PET損失與沉料中的異材。
將大顆異材集中與均勻分散兩情境比較抽樣結果。
在相同溫度改變停留時間並測材料殘水與黏度。
比較相同原料在不同含水率下加工前後IV。
逐一計算不同替代物的去除並找出限制項。
讓去除率降低一點，觀察殘餘值的倍數變化。
加入設備持料量後擴大追溯範圍。
找出缺少關鍵紀錄的兩批並保持待審狀態。
evidenceEn: Compare receiving records with non-target items in stratified samples.
Track difficult contaminants through both stages to test correlated misses.
Measure PET loss in floats and foreign resin in sinks.
Compare sampling of clustered large fragments and uniformly dispersed contamination.
Change residence time at equal temperature and measure residual water and viscosity.
Compare before/after IV for equal feed processed at different moisture levels.
Calculate removal for each surrogate and identify the limiting case.
Reduce removal slightly and observe the multiplicative change in residue.
Add equipment hold-up to widen the traceability boundary.
Identify the two lots lacking critical records and keep them pending review.
pitfalls: 只以透明外觀篩選會漏掉同色異材與不同前用途。
直接相乘名目效率會忽略兩段共同看不見的異材。
只量沉料總重會把異材重量當PET。
一小杯未見異材不能證明整噸無異材。
料層短路可能讓平均乾燥條件掩蓋濕料。
忽略測試條件可能把方法偏差誤認熱降解。
只展示最好去除率會隱藏難去除污染。
四捨五入成100%去除會錯誤得到零殘餘。
只隔離警報時刻的一袋會漏掉管線及反應器存料。
用全廠平均紀錄補填缺失批次會破壞追溯。
pitfallsEn: Transparency alone misses same-colour foreign resins and previous uses.
Multiplying nominal efficiencies ignores contaminants missed by both.
Sink mass alone counts foreign resin as PET.
No visible contamination in one small cup does not prove a tonne is clean.
Bed short-circuiting can conceal wet material behind average dryer conditions.
Ignoring test conditions can mistake method bias for thermal degradation.
Reporting only the best removal conceals difficult contaminants.
Rounding removal to100% falsely produces zero residue.
Isolating one bag at alarm time misses material in equipment.
Filling missing lot records with plant averages breaks traceability.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 垃圾自動真空收集
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
